Steps

It is used to display each link of the operation process and let users understand the position of the current operation in the overall process.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Import components in app.json or index.json.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-steps": "@macle/maui/steps/index"
}

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

<maui-steps steps="{{ steps }}" active="{{ active }}" />

Page({
  data: {
    steps: [
      {
        text: 'Step 1',
        desc: 'Description'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 2',
        desc: 'Description'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 3',
        desc: 'Description'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 4',
        desc: 'Description'
      }
    ]
  }
});

2. Custom style

The icon and color in the active state can be set through the active-icon and active-color properties.

<maui-steps steps="{{ steps }}" active="{{ active }}" active-icon="success" active-color="#38f" />

3. Custom icon

The icon of each item can be set separately through the inactiveIcon and activeIcon properties.

<maui-steps steps="{{ steps }}" active="{{ active }}" />

Page({
  data: {
    steps: [
      {
        text: 'Step 1',
        desc: 'Description',
        inactiveIcon: 'location-o',
        activeIcon: 'success'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 2',
        desc: 'Description',
        inactiveIcon: 'like-o',
        activeIcon: 'plus'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 3',
        desc: 'Description',
        inactiveIcon: 'star-o',
        activeIcon: 'cross'
      },
      {
        text: 'Step 4',
        desc: 'Description',
        inactiveIcon: 'phone-o',
        activeIcon: 'fail'
      }
    ]
  }
});

4. Vertical step bar

You can change the way the step bar is displayed by setting the direction attribute.

<maui-steps steps="{{ steps }}" active="{{ active }}" direction="vertical" active-color="#ee0a24" />

API

Steps Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
active current step Number 0
steps Step configuration collection, see configuration items below Step configuration item array []
direction Display direction, optional values ​​are horizontal vertical String horizontal
active-color Activation state color String #07c160
inactive-color Inactive status color String #969799
active-icon The icon at the bottom of the activated state. See the Icon component for optional values. String checked
inactive-icon The bottom icon in the inactive state. See the Icon component for optional values. String -

Events

event name Description Callback parameter
bind:clickstep Event triggered when a step is clicked event.detail: index of the current step

Step configuration items

Key Description Type
text Current step name String
desc Current step description information String
activeIcon Current step activation status bottom icon String
inactiveIcon The bottom icon of the inactive status of the current step. See the Icon component for optional values. String
